mechanism: Finite MDP states for tabular cross-entropy RL are made by SoftMax k-means clustering (Clusters=500) of a HistoryBars=20 window of OHLC ranges plus RSI, CCI, ATR, MACD main/signal. Each bar maps to argmax cluster id; Agent policy is a Clusters×Actions matrix updated from top-Percentile reward passes. Discretizes continuous FX microstructure into a regime codebook for RL.

mechanism: Cross-entropy RL: for each of Samples full environment passes, at every clustered state pick ArgMax policy action (or random if prob≤uniform); reward +1/−1 vs fractal target; keep passes with CumReward≥Percentile; recount action frequencies per state and renormalize rows to a stochastic policy. Iterates until reward plateaus. Policy π(a|s) is the sensor output.
data_needed: states/actions matrices Samples×T; CumRewards; policy matrix Clusters×Actions; Percentile (e.g. 70); Actions=3 (high/low/neither fractal)

quote: Of all the passes, we select from 20% to 50% of the best passes by the total rewards and update the Agent's policy based on the results.

mechanism: On a WindowSize sliding close window in CMatrixDouble: trend=OLS slope vs bar index, momentum=last−first, volatility=Std(); Score=TrendWeight*trend+MomentumWeight*momentum−VolatilityWeight*volatility. Positive score=bullish structure (rise+low vol), negative=bearish. Matrix fusion of three forces into one Market Score regime read.
data_needed: Close series; CMatrixDouble window; weights (default 0.4/0.3/0.3); WindowSize=50
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF via applied price; tested Volatility 75(1) Index M15; EMAPeriod=200 optional filter

quote: Score = TrendWeight * trend + MomentumWeight * momentum - VolatilityWeight * volatility

mechanism: Buy when previous Score>0 and current Score<BuyThreshold (default −10); sell when previous Score<0 and current Score>SellThreshold (+10). Requires crossing from the opposite-sign side so continuing trends do not re-fire; MinBarsBetween cooldown and optional EMA side filter; alerts once per forming bar. Detects bullish/bearish exhaustion flips.
data_needed: ScoreBuffer prev/curr; BuyThreshold/SellThreshold; MinBarsBetween; optional EMABuffer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Volatility 75(1) Index M15 defaults; WindowSize=50; EMA 200
why_new_for_mis: Regime-change sensor that fires only on opposite-sign exhaustion crosses of the composite score—not raw zero-line flips.
quote: a buy signal occurs when the score crosses from positive territory below a negative threshold (e.g., -10), and a sell signal when it crosses from negative territory above a positive threshold (e.g., +10).

mechanism: Replace IV with historical volatility (day/week/month by tenor); RelativePrice=(price−Strike)/HV; Call/Put Long/Short deltas via sigmoids 1/(1+exp(−K*(±x−S))) with S≈0.5; rebalance underlying volume on hysteresis levels of |delta| in N steps. HV-normalized distance-to-strike drives position delta—volatility-scaled structure sensor.
data_needed: Strike; HV for tenor; koeff_K/S; OptionContractsVolume hysteresis arrays; Vmin lot/step
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Underlying any (MOEX SBRF futures example strike 31000); HV window matches expiration tenor; continuous rebalance
why_new_for_mis: Uses HV-normalized moneyness sigmoid as a live volatility-scaled delta sensor for synthetic option exposure—portable where listed options are missing.
quote: Then the relative increment from the 'price' is expressed by the following ratio: Relative Price(price) = (price - Strike) / HV.

mechanism: With Part 1 emulation: Long Straddle/Strangle when expecting move beyond HV range (direction unknown); Short Straddle/Strangle when expecting price to stay inside HV (range). Strangle strikes at ±StrangleKoeffStrike*HV. Daily HV refresh sets the regime boundary; PnL comes from delta rebalances inside/outside that band.
data_needed: Daily HV; strike(s); StrangleKoeffStrike 0.01–0.10; Long/Short Put+Call construction deltas; level visualization
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Underlying FX examples (AUDUSD M5 charts in figs); intraday levels from day open; HV for current day
